name: LILYGO T-Deck

display.notes: Live display needs-runtime-host; ST7789 pins/res/rotation differ from compiled es3c28p host.

touch_input.keyboard: ESP32-C3 keyboard coprocessor I2C 0x55, KB INT GPIO46
touch_input.notes: GT911 protocol/registers differ from FT6336; regfile/host needs extension (needs-runtime-host). Keyboard/trackball not modeled.

audio.notes: I2S/speaker present in board caps (KryonOS v3); conditional(version/tool).

storage.sd: MicroSD SPI on shared display bus, SD CS 39 (MISO38 MOSI41 SCLK40)
storage.sd_emulation: conditional(version/tool): esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd (ESP32-S3 SDMMC); board wiring not verified
storage.notes: LoRa CS held high GPIO9 (bus isolation) per KryonOS v3 notes.

local.notes: No dedicated local emu env in repo docs.

pins.notes: From KryonOS v3.0.0 prep (t_deck.ini/BoardConfig). GPS/LoRa variants exist; validate per hardware.

notes: Closest input model type to es3c28p (I2C touch) but different controller (GT911).
May hang/behave oddly without keyboard coprocessor/trackball/GPS models.
Touch mapping flags in KryonOS v3: SWAP_XY=1, INV_Y=1 (config-specific).
